data.description:
## Why

A vocabulary migration that is not guarded regresses: the next author or generated prompt
reintroduces the old heading and nothing notices. This story closes the epic by proving the
live vocabulary is gone and adding the check that keeps it gone — while ensuring the guard
cannot fire on the frozen records and unrelated `O-RAN-SC` occurrences that must NEVER change.

## What

Sweep for residual SC vocabulary and add a CI guard against reintroduction.

## Scope

- A guard script under `scripts/` (wired into the existing lint/CI gates) failing the build when
  `Success Criteria` / `success criteria` / `success criterion` or a bare `SC` used as that
  abbreviation appears in live source.
- Its allowlist, which must exempt:
  - `tests/fixtures/jira/search.json` and `tests/fixtures/jira/comment_map.json` — recorded
    Jira payloads/comment text (one contains "parent SC"); these are captured records and
    editing them changes the thing under test.
  - `docs/archive/`, `docs/experiments/` — historical material.
  - Historical citations to a past ticket's numbered criterion:
    `tests/scripts/reducer/test_reducer_reduce_all.py:120`,
    `tests/interfaces/store/test_canonical_event_bytes.py:1`,
    `tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py:414`.
  - `O-RAN-SC` — the Linux Foundation telecom consortium — in `docs/adr/0021-replication-change-refs.md:13`,
    `docs/adr/0022-g2p-in-container.md:13,21`, `docs/adr/0023-inbound-github-gerrit-ssh-vote.md:13`
    and `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:10`.
  - `src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/dist/editor.js` — minified vendor bundle.

## Approach

The guard matches the exact phrase case-insensitively, plus `\bSCs?\b` restricted to the paths
where the abbreviation could plausibly mean Success Criteria (`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/`,
`src/rebar/_guides/`, `criteria_routing.json`). Scoping the bare-token rule by PATH rather than
by a global word-boundary match is what keeps `O-RAN-SC` out of it without a fragile negative
lookahead.

The allowlist is a data file, not inline regex, so an exemption is reviewable as a diff.

## Testing

- The guard fails on a deliberately reintroduced `## Success Criteria` in a live source file.
- The guard PASSES on the current tree with the allowlist applied.
- A test asserting the four `O-RAN-SC` sites and the two Jira fixtures do not trip it.
- Verify the four `O-RAN-SC` occurrences are byte-identical to their pre-migration content.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `scripts/` carries a guard script wired into an existing CI gate; it exits non-zero on a
      reintroduced `## Success Criteria` in live source (proven by a test that injects one).
- [ ] The guard exits 0 on the migrated tree.
- [ ] A test asserts the guard does NOT fire on the four `O-RAN-SC` sites, the two
      `tests/fixtures/jira/` files, or the three historical-citation sites.
- [ ] `git diff` against the pre-migration base shows the four `O-RAN-SC` occurrences and
      `editor.js` unchanged.
- [ ] A full-repo sweep confirms no live-source SC vocabulary remains outside the allowlist.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the full pytest suite pass.
data.title: Sweep residual Success Criteria vocabulary and guard against reintroduction
